_comment: Relationship tier template (Docs/TextAuthoring/Plan_CommandCases.md D41), inserted into kojo cases that name it (cases.json "tiers"). The relationship system is being reworked: edit the tiers here, no code change. A kojo branch covers a tier when a variant on its path has every field in `match` (fields of the variant or of its requirement); an empty match = the catch-all branch with none of the other tiers' fields. required: false = tier sub-cases are optional.
